title: Japan Autumn Getaway| Tokyo, Nikko, Yudanaka & Matsumoto
highlights: This Japan autumn journey takes you through Tokyo, Nikko, Karuizawa, Yudanaka, and Matsumoto, combining vibrant fall foliage, scenic landscapes, and unique Japanese experiences.
Enjoy a hands-on Daruma painting experience in Takasaki, where you can learn about this traditional Japanese symbol and create your own Daruma doll to take home.
Discover Matsumoto Castle, known as the “Crow Castle” for its distinctive black exterior, and explore one of Japan’s most iconic historic castles.
Enjoy a high-speed train journey from Matsumoto to Tokyo, offering a comfortable and convenient transfer while taking in views of Japan’s scenic countryside.
Travel with organized airport transfers, comfortable accommodations, and guided sightseeing, making the short Japan tour smooth and well-coordinated.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience Japan’s autumn charm on a 5-day journey through Tokyo, Nikko, Takasaki, Karuizawa, Yudanaka, and Matsumoto. Begin in Tokyo with a convenient airport meet-and-greet before travelling to Nikko, where you can explore Rinnoji Temple, Toshogu Shrine, Kegon Falls, and Lake Chuzenji surrounded by vibrant autumn foliage. Continue to Takasaki for a traditional Daruma painting experience before exploring Karuizawa’s unique Stone Church and contemporary art scene. Stay in a Japanese-style ryokan in Yudanaka and visit Jigokudani Monkey Park to see Japanese macaques in their natural hot-spring surroundings. Discover the historic Matsumoto Castle, known as “Crow Castle,” before returning to Tokyo by express train. End your journey with a convenient airport transfer, taking home a mix of seasonal landscapes, cultural experiences, historic landmarks, and traditional Japanese hospitality.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
2 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
1 night stay in Nikko with breakfast
Nikko Heritage & Scenic Highlights Tour - Ticket/Cost not included
1 night stay in Karuizawa with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Narita International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: The itinerary includes walking at temples, gardens, waterfalls, and other outdoor attractions, so comfortable walking shoes are recommended.
Autumn foliage and weather conditions can vary by location and season, so the exact fall colours and temperatures cannot be guaranteed.
The Snow Monkey Park involves a walk on uneven and forested paths, so suitable footwear is recommended.
Traditional Japanese accommodation may include tatami rooms, futon-style bedding, and shared or communal bathing facilities.
Please note that only breakfast is included so any additional meals, drinks, or personal expenses are at your own cost.
Guests extending their stay before or after the tour will need to arrange their own transfers unless additional hotel and transfer arrangements are booked in advance.
Travel times may vary depending on traffic, weather, road conditions, and seasonal congestion.
Autumn weather can be cool, particularly in Nikko, Karuizawa, Yudanaka, and other mountainous areas, so layered clothing is recommended.
Entry to attractions is subject to their operating schedules and may be affected by maintenance, weather, or local restrictions.
Guests should carry a valid passport and any required travel documents throughout the tour.
Personal expenses such as additional meals, beverages, shopping, tips, and optional activities are not included unless specifically mentioned.
Guests should follow local instructions and photography guidelines at temples, shrines, museums, and other cultural sites.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to your hotel and complete the check-in process. After settling in, spend the rest of the day at leisure and experience Tokyo’s autumn charm at your own pace. You can visit Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden and enjoy a walk surrounded by seasonal foliage. Also, you can stroll along Meiji Jingu Gaien’s famous Icho Namiki avenue, lined with vibrant yellow ginkgo trees, or explore the traditional Rikugien Gardens, known for its autumn colours.

items.title: Meiji Jingu Gaien – Icho Namiki Avenue
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Transfer to Nikko | Nikko Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Check out & get driven to Nikko. Upon arrival, check in to the hotel and relax. Later, begin your sightseeing tour from Rinnoji Temple. Also, visit the Treasure House, home to Buddhist statues and stroll through Shoyoen Garden, known for its beautiful autumn foliage. Continue to Toshogu Shrine, Nikko’s renowned UNESCO World Heritage site, and admire its ornate architecture and famous carvings. Later, visit Kegon Falls, one of Japan’s most iconic waterfalls, & explore the shores of Lake Chuzenji.

days.title: Transfer to Karuizawa via Takasaki | En Route Sightseeing
days.desc: Check-out and get driven to Karuizawa via Takasaki. Once in Takasaki, visit Shorinzan Daruma Temple, known for its connection to Daruma dolls, and enjoy a hands-on Daruma Painting Experience where you can create your own traditional keepsake. Continue to Karuizawa and explore the unique Stone Church, distinguished by its striking stone-and-glass arches. Later, visit the Karuizawa Museum of Contemporary Art, showcasing works by Japanese artists. Later, check-in to your hotel and relax.

days.title: Transfer to Tokyo | Visit to Jigokudani Monkey Park and Matsumoto Castle
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Yudanaka and visit Jigokudani Monkey Park, home to Japan’s famous Japanese macaques, also known as Snow Monkeys. Walk through the forested surroundings and watch the monkeys as they relax, groom one another, and soak in the natural hot springs. Continue to Matsumoto & visit the iconic Matsumoto Castle, known for its distinctive black exterior and the nickname “Crow Castle.” Later, board an express train to Tokyo & upon arrival, head to the hotel for check-in.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train will be Provided

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get driven to the airport. Once at the airport, board your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing trip!
